sources.title: Heuristic Evaluations: How to Conduct
supports: Heuristic inspection and user testing serve different evidence needs.
caveats: Not a game UI certification or proof of effectiveness for this project.

sources.title: Evaluate Interface Learnability with Cognitive Walkthroughs
supports: Task-step inspection of goals, discoverability, action mapping, and feedback.
caveats: An expert walkthrough does not replace observing target players.

sources.title: Involving Users in Evaluating Web Accessibility
supports: Combine technical evaluation with relevant user involvement and bound conclusions to the sample.
caveats: Web-focused guidance; method transfer does not certify a native game.
